query: What signals suggest an agent's tickets will take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: resolution_days
per_column.rationale: This is resolution_time itself expressed in days (elapsed close - open time), a direct restatement of the focus variable. Its values mirror days_in_system. Using it to predict resolution_time is trivial leakage.

per_column.name: priority_level
per_column.rationale: Ticket priority is known at intake, lies outside the outcome, and plausibly carries signal about how long resolution takes. Legitimate predictor (though it largely mirrors the existing priority column).

per_column.name: is_network_category
per_column.rationale: A category-derived flag known at ticket creation; category type can plausibly influence resolution duration without restating the outcome.

per_column.name: same_agent
per_column.rationale: Whether the assigned agent matches (e.g., updater/caller) is knowable independently of resolution length and could plausibly relate to speed. Weak but legitimate.

per_column.name: agent_changed
per_column.rationale: Exact complement of same_agent (401/99 mirror inverted), providing no additional information beyond same_agent. Redundant.

per_column.name: is_open
per_column.rationale: Whether the ticket is still open is determined by the resolution/closure state; open tickets have no realized resolution time (the 22 NULLs in resolution_days). It reflects the outcome status rather than predicting it.

per_column.name: days_in_system
per_column.rationale: Values coincide with resolution_days; for closed tickets this is time in system = resolution duration. A restatement of the focus with leakage.

per_column.name: is_critical_domain
per_column.rationale: A domain/criticality flag derivable from category or description at intake; plausibly correlated with resolution time and not a function of the outcome.

per_column.name: self_assigned
per_column.rationale: Constant value (0 for all 500 rows). A zero-variance feature carries no predictive signal.

judge.rationale: The set is contaminated by direct leakage/restatement of the focus (resolution_days, days_in_system are the outcome; is_open reflects closure status). agent_changed duplicates same_agent, and self_assigned is constant. The genuine intake-time predictors (priority_level, is_network_category, same_agent, is_critical_domain) are legitimate but largely overlap existing columns (priority, category), so incremental predictive leverage beyond the original table is modest.
